Physical Description: No-Hives are similar to other Formians; centaur-like ant creatures with a red exoskeleton, however No-Hives are usually branded or marked in some way to denote their status as lacking a hive to call their own. This is usually black paint from their head all the way down to their abdomen, and is usually done either by other Formians or even by themselves. Otherwise they are similar visually to other Formians somewhere between a Worker and Warrior.

Society: No-Hives are defined instead by their lack of a society due to their being outside of a hive; No-Hives are few and far between and due to their rarity a group of No-Hive have not come together to create a whole new society.

Relations: No-Hives often make a conceited effort to get along with other races – even if the race is not normally interested in friendly relationships with No-Hives.

Alignment and Religion: No-Hives tend to remain similar to their past brethren and are strictly Lawful, preferring routine despite their lack of a hive – instead making their own code for themselves to follow. They are more flexible when it comes to the Good/Evil axis; some more noble No-Hives even becoming Paladins or knights in rare cases, or more devious Lawful Evil No-Hives attain a knack for manipulation.

Adventurers: Formian No-Hives are the most common of the Formian adventurers due to their lack of a hive, allowing them to remain independent. Usually adventure is their only other route in life as most societies are fearful of the new and bizarre Formians, only willing to give them jobs which keep them far from towns such as hiring them as hunters.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: No-Hives are disconnected from their main hive, making them think more independently but suffer from social ineptitude. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Charisma.
Size: No-Hives are medium creatures and thus receive no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Type: No-Hives are monstrous humanoids.
Base Speed: No-Hives have a base speed of 30 feet.
Languages: No-Hives begin play speaking Common and Formian. No-Hives with a high Intelligence scores can choose from any language they want (except for secret languages such as Druidic).

Defense Racial Traits

Exoskeleton: No-Hives receive a +2 natural armor bonus to AC.
Sonic Resistance: No-Hives have Sonic Resistance 10.
Multi-Legged: No-Hives receive a +4 bonus to CMD against trip attempts.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

Expert Climber: No-Hives are capable of climbing having a climb speed of 10 feet, and they receive a +5 racial bonus to Climb checks.

Senses Racial Traits

Darkvision: No-Hives can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

Magic Racial Traits

Ant’s Strength: No-Hives are able to cast Ant Haul upon themselves a number of times per day equal to their Intelligence modifier (minimum of one times per day). They treat their character level as their caster level for this.
Alternate Racial Traits
Burrower: These No-Hives are capable of burrowing deep into the ground beneath them, granting them a burrow speed of 10 feet. This replaces Expert Climber.
Resistant Shell: No-Hives with powerful shells which can resist elements. They have Fire and Electricity Resistance 5. This replaces Sonic Resistance.
